title: Scan ID fuzzy match: `baseScanId.startsWith(k)` can wrongly match shorter scan IDs
NotificationMenu renders `notification.title` — field absent in Notification model — title label always blank
description:
**File:** `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/notifications/NotificationMenu.js` (and `NotificationMenu_chakra.js`)
**Line:** 118
**Root Cause:** `{notification.title}` is rendered in the header row, but the Notification MongoDB schema and `dispatch()` payload have no `title` field. The human-readable content is in `message`.
**Impact:** The bold colored label at the top of each notification item is always empty — the notification looks broken with no identifying header text.
**Fix:** Replace `notification.title` with a formatted `notificationType` label (e.g., `'task_assigned'` → `'Task Assigned'`). Also align `getNotificationColor` call to use `notification.notificationType` (see NOTIF-013).
fixEvidence: Both menu files: `{notification.title}` → `{formatType(notification.notificationType)}` with helper that formats snake_case to Title Case

title: `notificationService.js` preference methods call non-existent backend endpoints (`/notifications/events`, `/notifications/preferences/*`) — all 404
description:
**File:** `vibrantix-client-panel/src/services/notificationService.js`
**Root Cause:** `getNotificationEvents()`, `getEventsByCategory()`, `getProjectPreferences()`, `upsertProjectPreferences()`, `upsertNotificationRule()`, `deleteNotificationRule()`, `updateGlobalSettings()`, `getOrganizationUsers()` call endpoints that do not exist in `vibrantix-backend/src/modules/notification/notification.routes.js`. The actual routes are limited to `/unread-count`, `/client`, `/mark-all-read`, `/:id/read`, `/:id`.
**Impact:** Any component using these preference methods gets a 404 error. Notification preference settings pages cannot load or save preferences.
**Fix:** Either implement the missing backend routes (`GET /events`, `GET /preferences/:projectId`, `PUT /preferences/:projectId`, etc.) or clearly stub these methods as unimplemented. The inbox methods (`getMyNotifications`, `getUnreadCount`, `markAsRead`, `markAllAsRead`, `deleteNotification`) are correct.
